senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) rear, consequence; (conj.) in consequence of; (homilet.) end, future world.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 3:3">Deut. R. s. 3</cite> (play on <he>עקב</he>, <cite ref="Deuteronomy 7:12">Deut. VII, 12</cite>) <he>אבל שכרן בע׳ אני וכ׳</he> (not <he>שכרו</he>) but their full reward I shall give you in the end (after death); Yalk. ib. 847 <he>שכר הקרן בע׳ וכ׳</he>. Deut. R. l. c. <he>אני מייסר אתכם עד הע׳</he> I shall try you to the end (of your lives); <he>עד שתשמרו … עד הע׳</he> until you shall observe my commandments to the end.
